curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /k/, /d/ and /w/ in preparation for reading

mission.title: Sound Spotters: k, d and w

interactions.prompt: Listen to /k/. Tap the word that begins with that sound.
interactions.feedback: Yes! Knee begins with the /k/ sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: At the school word wall, watch how words are sorted by their first sound: /k/, /d/ or /w/.
interactions.feedback: Each word joins the group with its opening sound.
interactions.retryHint: Stretch the first sound before saying the rest of the word.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to its first sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say kid, desk and wash aloud one at a time.

interactions.prompt: Tap all words that begin with /w/.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Wave and walk begin with /w/.
interactions.retryHint: Your lips round when you begin the /w/ sound.

interactions.prompt: Sort these body-and-action words: kick, dance, wink, knee, dig, wash.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You used sounds to prepare for fluent reading.
interactions.retryHint: Listen only to the beginning of each word.
